package.name: xlerobot_lerobot
package.description: LeRobot on top of the ROS 2 stack, for the operator station (the Mac): record leader-arm demonstrations from the camera, joint state and arm command topics into a LeRobot dataset, and run a trained policy (SmolVLA) that sends its action chunks to the arm controllers as JointTrajectory messages. lerobot is not in the control path (ADR-0001); it is a client of the topics. The modules run on the LeRobot venv's Python (tools/setup_venv.sh lerobot, tools/lerobot.sh), with rclpy from the ROS install.
